purpose: Verify unused responsive-image candidate cancellation without suppressing genuine request failures.

method.description: Delay 400w image candidates while changing from three desktop columns to two tablet columns.

requiredConditionsForExpectedCancellatio: The failure is exactly net::ERR_ABORTED for an image request.
The failed URL is one of the twelve known local partner-photo srcset URLs.
The same photo declares the failed candidate and a different selected candidate in its srcset.
The selected replacement is a known local photo source, complete, with positive natural dimensions.
The selected replacement successfully decoded and its recorded response status is 200.
automatedRunSummary: Each npm test run writes test-results/request-summary.json with every failed request, verified responsive replacement, and unexpected error. Requests that do not meet every required condition still fail the test.
